items.en: The 2026 World Nomad Games are underway. 2026
items.zh: 年世界游牧民族运动会正在举行

items.en: They include what Reuters News describes as traditional events in nomadic Central Asian cultures.
items.zh: 据路透社报道，赛事包括中亚游牧文化中的传统项目

items.en: But some of the features of this week's opening ceremonies in Bishkek,
items.zh: 但本周在吉尔吉斯斯坦首都比什凯克举行的开幕式上，

items.en: the capital of Kyrgyzstan, were spectacles in themselves.
items.zh: 有些环节本身就是一场视觉盛宴

items.en: Animated creatures that thankfully aren't that big in real life took the stage,
items.zh: 幸好现实中没那么巨大的动画生物登上了舞台，

items.en: along with horse-drawn chariots and scenes over an animated floor that were choreographed to traditional music.
items.zh: 伴随着马拉战车，以及动画地板上配合传统音乐编排的场景

items.en: There was also a misted waterfall that streamed down and set a surreal backdrop to an extraordinary equestrian exhibition.
items.zh: 还有一道雾气蒙蒙的瀑布倾泻而下，为一场非凡的马术表演营造出超现实的背景

items.en: And the effects aimed to give the crowd,
items.zh: 这些效果旨在给观众、

items.en: the athletes and the performers something to remember.
items.zh: 运动员和表演者留下难忘的回忆

items.en: Organizers say participants from 104 countries registered for the sixth edition of the World Nomad Games.
items.zh: 主办方表示，有来自104个国家的选手报名参加第六届世界游牧民族运动会

items.en: They'll be competing in everything from archery and wrestling to board games and hunting with eagles.
items.zh: 他们将参与从射箭、摔跤到棋类游戏和猎鹰等各类比赛

items.en: And the 2026 events are a homecoming of sorts,
items.zh: 而2026年的赛事某种程度上是一次回归，

items.en: as Kyrgyzstan was the first nation to host them.
items.zh: 因为吉尔吉斯斯坦是第一个举办该运动会的国家

items.en: This is the world from A to Z.
items.zh: 这就是《从A到Z看世界》

items.en: Welcome to everyone watching worldwide.
items.zh: 欢迎世界各地收看节目的各位

items.en: I'm Carl Azuz.
items.zh: 我是卡尔·阿祖兹

items.en: Does artificial intelligence have a place in the classroom?
items.zh: 人工智能在课堂上该有一席之地吗？

items.en: Big topic right now.
items.zh: 这是当下的一大话题

items.en: And New York City says no,
items.zh: 而纽约市给出的答案是不行，

items.en: at least not for students in pre-kindergarten through 8th grade.
items.zh: 至少在学前班到八年级的学生中不允许

items.en: When they resume school there in exactly one week,
items.zh: 他们再过整整一周就要返校，

items.en: 600,000 of them will not be allowed to use generative AI,
items.zh: 届时60万名学生将不得使用生成式人工智能，

items.en: the kind that allows people to give instructions and have the technology produce text, pictures,
items.zh: 也就是那种可以让人们下达指令、由技术生成文字、图片、

items.en: videos or other data that reportedly includes chatbots.
items.zh: 视频或其他数据的人工智能，据报道其中包括聊天机器人

items.en: They're out.
items.zh: 聊天机器人被排除在外

items.en: New York City is also recommending reduced screen time for kids in an effort to encourage more social interaction.
items.zh: 纽约市还建议减少孩子们的屏幕时间，以鼓励更多社交互动

items.en: There will be exceptions to these rules on remote learning days or for students with disabilities, for example.
items.zh: 这些规定也会有例外，比如在远程学习日或针对残障学生

items.en: Teachers will still be allowed to use AI for lesson plans and other educational work.
items.zh: 教师仍可使用人工智能来制定教案和完成其他教学工作

items.en: And the ban does not apply to high school students.
items.zh: 而这项禁令不适用于高中生

items.en: They'll get new lessons concerning AI literacy and its potential shortcomings.
items.zh: 他们将接受有关人工智能素养及其潜在缺陷的新课程

items.en: But the district says they'll still have access to AI as part of their preparation for a world that uses it.
items.zh: 但学区表示，高中生仍可接触人工智能，作为他们为使用人工智能的世界做准备的一部分

items.en: So why the ban in pre-k through 8th grade?
items.zh: 那么为什么要在学前班到八年级实施禁令呢？

items.en: Critics of AI, including many parents who've spoken out against it,
items.zh: 人工智能的批评者，包括许多公开反对的家长，

items.en: say kids increasingly rely on that instead of learning to think critically.
items.zh: 认为孩子们越来越依赖它，而不是学会批判性思考

items.en: And New York's mayor says they need to interact with other humans to sharpen their social and problem solving skills.
items.zh: 而纽约市长表示，孩子们需要与他人互动，以磨炼社交和解决问题的能力

items.en: Supporters of AI in the classroom say if used properly, it can help students learn,
items.zh: 支持人工智能进课堂的人表示，如果使用得当，它可以帮助学生学习，

items.en: guiding them to think through different scenarios and also custom tailoring lessons to individual students' needs.
items.zh: 引导他们思考不同情境，还能根据个别学生的需求定制课程

items.en: The educational impact of all this,
items.zh: 这一切对教育的影响，

items.en: along with whether other school systems will follow New York's lead, remains to be seen.
items.zh: 以及其他学校系统是否会效仿纽约的做法，还有待观察

items.en: New York City is the largest school district in America.
items.zh: 纽约市是美国最大的学区

items.en: Where in the world?
items.zh: 这是哪里？

items.en: This is a nation that was established in 1768.
items.zh: 这是一个建立于1768年的国家

items.en: It's landlocked in southern Asia between India and China.
items.zh: 它位于南亚内陆，夹在印度和中国之间

items.en: It's home to 8 of the world's 10 highest mountain peaks in its capital is Kathmandu.
items.zh: 它拥有世界十大最高山峰中的八座，首都是加德满都

items.en: This is Nepal, a country of more than 29 million people.
items.zh: 这就是尼泊尔，一个拥有超过2900 万人口的国家

items.en: Along Nepal's border with Tibet, an autonomous region of China,
items.zh: 在尼泊尔与中国西藏自治区接壤的边境一带，

items.en: rescuers are doing all they can to find anyone who may still be alive after catastrophic flash floods struck on August 26.
items.zh: 救援人员正尽一切努力搜寻8月26日灾难性山洪暴发后可能仍活着的人

items.en: Officials believe the disaster was triggered when part of a glacier collapsed.
items.zh: 官员们认为，这场灾难是由部分冰川崩塌引发的

items.en: That caused towering floodwaters in rivers and valleys below, washing away bridges and villages.
items.zh: 这导致下方河流和山谷中洪水滔天，冲毁了桥梁和村庄

items.en: Most of the deaths were in Nepal.
items.zh: 大多数遇难者位于尼泊尔

items.en: At least 1,200 lives were lost there, according to the nation's government.
items.zh: 据该国政府称，那里至少有1200人丧生

items.en: More than 4,000 people are still missing.
items.zh: 仍有4000多人失踪

items.en: And Chinese officials say there are more than 500 missing and 21 dead in Tibet.
items.zh: 而中国官员表示，西藏有500多人失踪、21人死亡

items.en: Assistance is coming in from all over the world.
items.zh: 援助正从世界各地涌来

items.en: And rescue officials say roughly 12,000 people have been saved.
items.zh: 救援官员表示，大约有 1.2万人获救

items.en: It's been one week since disaster struck, and in Tresuli,
items.zh: 灾难发生至今已有一周，在德里苏利，

items.en: this is the end of the road.
items.zh: 这条路到了尽头

items.en: Once a bustling market, now soggy and cement-soaked, it looks like a wasteland.
items.zh: 这里曾是繁华的市场，如今湿漉漉地浸满水泥，看上去像一片废墟

items.en: The river is running fast.
items.zh: 河水湍急

items.en: The water is still high.
items.zh: 水位仍然很高

items.en: Residents and visitors stand and stare.
items.zh: 居民和游客驻足凝视

items.en: Traffic snarls on broken roads.
items.zh: 破损的道路上交通拥堵

items.en: The jackknife truck is hardly noticed.
items.zh: 那辆折成V字形的卡车几乎无人注意

items.en: A local school bus driver, Chiring Tamang, saved the lives of some 50 children,
items.zh: 当地校车司机奇林·塔芒救了大约50名孩子的命，

items.en: picking them up just before their school was destroyed and crossing a bridge before it was washed away.
items.zh: 他在学校被毁前接上他们，又在一座桥被冲走前过了桥

items.en: After two minutes of me crossing the bridge, the flood came on my side.
items.zh: 我过桥两分钟后，洪水冲到了我这边

items.en: Kids started screaming after seeing the flood.
items.zh: 看到洪水，孩子们开始尖叫

items.en: They were shouting.
items.zh: 他们在大喊

items.en: One kid fainted inside the bus.
items.zh: 一个孩子在车里晕了过去

items.en: They were asking me to drive faster.
items.zh: 他们让我开快一点

items.en: On the road, there were people running like ants to save their lives.
items.zh: 路上人们像蚂蚁一样狂奔逃命

items.en: After I drove near the uphill,
items.zh: 等我开到上坡附近时，

items.en: I could see the flood is already ahead of me.
items.zh: 我看到洪水已经在我前面了

items.en: I reached a higher location, and I felt safe with the kids.
items.zh: 我到了地势更高的地方，和孩子们在一起才觉得安全了

items.en: I took a long breath, and then I continued my duty of dropping the kids,
items.zh: 我长长地舒了一口气，然后继续送孩子们回家，

items.en: came back, and parked the bus at the police station.
items.zh: 回来把校车停在警察局

items.zh: 希望明天你还能与我们一起同行

items.en: You mean the world to me.
items.zh: 你对我来说就是全世界
